run_vlm_batch_inference: run offline batch inference with a vision-language model using sglang Engine and ServerArgs CLI
create_vlm_engine: create an sglang Engine instance from ServerArgs for vision-language model generation
run_vlm_generate: run vlm.generate with a prompt, image_url, and sampling_params to produce text output
build_server_args: build ServerArgs from CLI arguments using argparse and ServerArgs.add_cli_args
shutdown_vlm_engine: shutdown the vlm Engine instance after generating output
